local emul = {
  physical = { fire=100, water=100, nature=100, neutral=100, ghost=0 },
  fire = { fire=50, water=50, nature=200, neutral=100, ghost=100 },
  water = { fire=200, water=50, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100 },
  nature = { fire=50, water=200, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100 },
}
local function num(v, d) if v == nil then return d end return v end
local function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
  local atk = attacker.atk
  local alevel = attacker.level
  local crit_chance = num(attacker.crit_chance, 0)
  local crit_mult = num(attacker.crit_mult, 150)
  local pen_pct = num(attacker.pen_pct, 0)
  local pen_flat = num(attacker.pen_flat, 0)
  local hp = defender.hp
  local shield = num(defender.shield, 0)
  local armor = defender.armor
  local dlevel = defender.level
  local delem = defender.element
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = num(defender.guarding, false)
  local spower = skill.power
  local selem = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = num(skill.hits, 1)
  local true_damage = num(skill.true_damage, false)
  local seed = num(skill.seed, 0)
  local mrow = emul[selem] or emul.physical
  local absorbed = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local killed = false
  for k = 1, hits do
    if hp <= 0 then break end
    resolved = resolved + 1
    local m = mrow[delem] or 100
    local p = spower - 20*(k-1)
    if p < 10 then p = 10 end
    local d = floor(atk * p / 100)
    local diff = alevel - dlevel
    if diff < -10 then diff = -10 elseif diff > 10 then diff = 10 end
    d = floor(d * (100 + 3*diff) / 100)
    local iscrit = ((seed + 17*k) % 100) < crit_chance
    if iscrit then
      crits = crits + 1
      d = floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
    end
    local immune = false
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if iscrit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      local ea = floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
      d = floor(d * m / 100)
      local r = resist[selem] or 0
      if r < -50 then r = -50 elseif r > 80 then r = 80 end
      d = floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
      if m == 0 then immune = true end
    end
    if guarding then d = floor(d / 2) end
    if d < 1 and not immune then d = 1 end
    local a = shield
    if d < a then a = d end
    if a < 0 then a = 0 end
    shield = shield - a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and shield <= 0 then loss = floor(loss * 125 / 100) end
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      killed = true
    else
      hp = hp - loss
    end
  end
  return {
    damage = defender.hp - hp,
    absorbed = absorbed,
    hp = hp,
    shield = shield,
    overkill = overkill,
    crits = crits,
    hits = resolved,
    killed = killed,
  }
end
local function fmt(r)
  return string.format('damage=%d absorbed=%d hp=%d shield=%d overkill=%d crits=%d hits=%d killed=%s', r.damage, r.absorbed, r.hp, r.shield, r.overkill, r.crits, r.hits, tostring(r.killed))
end

local ex2 = fmt(resolve_attack({atk=90,level=3,crit_chance=50,crit_mult=200,pen_pct=40,pen_flat=10},{hp=300,shield=25,armor=60,level=20,element='fire',resist={water=-30},guarding=true},{power=100,element='water',hits=3,true_damage=false,seed=40}))
logic_define('resolve_attack', resolve_attack)
local out = ex1 .. ' || ' .. ex2
report(out)
return out"}

  if not coreai_world_exists(name) then return 'none' end

        local d = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)
        dist[i] = d
        if dmin == nil or d < dmin then dmin = d end
      end
    end
  end
  if not any then return 'none' end
  for i = 1, 8 do
    if dist[i] and dist[i] <= 1.01 * dmin then return 'Tower' .. i end
  end

  local cols = #grid[1]

  local sr,sc,gr,gc

    local row = grid[r]
    for c=1,cols do
      local ch = string.sub(row,c,c)

    end
  end
  local heap, hn = {}, 0
  local function hpush(id,c,a)
    hn=hn+1
    heap[hn]={id=id,c=c,a=a}
    local i=hn
    while i>1 do
      local p=math.floor(i/2)
      local x,y=heap[i],heap[p]
      if x.c<y.c or (x.c==y.c and x.a<y.a) then heap[i],heap[p]=y,x; i=p else break end
